groups.label: Git workflow
groups.summary: How the agent branches, commits, integrates and pushes.

options.label: Trunk-based
options.summary: Short-lived branch per track, kept rebased on main; history stays linear.
options.detail:
Branch from the latest main, rebase onto it often, and integrate quickly. Rewriting history is allowed **only on your own track branch**, never on `main`.

```
git fetch origin
git switch -c <track_id> origin/main
# … commit per the commit setting …
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease --force-if-includes origin <track_id>
# merge: fast-forward / rebase-merge into main, delete the branch
```

Tiny changes may go straight to main with `git pull --rebase origin main` then a plain `git push` (no force).

options.label: Feature branch + merge
options.summary: Branch per track, push normally, merge back with a merge commit. Pushed history is never rewritten.
options.detail:
Often called the *feature branch workflow* (or *GitHub Flow* when merges go through pull requests). It is not *Git Flow*, which adds long-lived `develop` and `release` branches.

```
git switch -c <track_id> main
# … commit per the commit setting …
git push -u origin <track_id>
# open a PR, or locally:
git switch main && git pull
git merge --no-ff <track_id>
git push origin main
```

options.label: Per task
options.summary: One commit per completed task, with its SHA recorded in plan.md. Easiest to review and revert.

options.label: Per phase
options.summary: One commit when a phase is complete.

options.label: Per track
options.summary: A single commit for the whole track.

options.label: Ask first
options.summary: The agent never pushes without asking in chat.

options.label: After each phase
options.summary: Push the track branch when a phase completes.

options.label: At track end
options.summary: Push once, when the whole track is complete and verified.

groups.label: Testing & verification
groups.summary: When tests are written and when the full suite and manual checks are run.

options.label: Test-first (TDD)
options.summary: Every task writes failing tests, then the code that makes them pass.

options.label: Tests after implementation
options.summary: Tasks implement features; tests are written together in the final verification phase.

options.label: End of every phase
options.summary: Run the full suite, walk through manual checks and get your sign-off after each phase.

options.label: Once, at track end
options.summary: Phases flow straight into each other; one final Track Verification phase runs everything and asks for sign-off.
